history.agent_note: Greenfield PWA Digital & Physical School Library
Spesifikasi BRD v1.0 mencakup Hybrid Circulation, E-Book PDF Reader dengan watermark, PWA Offline, dan Akun Lokal CSV.
Design System Modern Academic Minimalist, WCAG AA tokens, Reader sepia/dark themes, dan PWA iOS guide.
Modular Monolith, Clean Layered Architecture (Controller -> Service -> Repository), SQLite + Drizzle ORM, React + Vite PWA.
15 unit & integration tests passing 100%, zero security flaws, PWA offline precache verified.
Production multi-stage Dockerfile, docker-compose, CI/CD pipeline, and deployment documentation finalized.
Integrated Shadcn UI primitives (Dialog, AlertDialog, Tabs, Sonner, Command Palette) with tactile Aceternity accents (CardSpotlight, BentoGrid). Eliminated native alert/confirm.

Fixed non-functioning and missing features: Admin CSV member import (backend route, service with flexible header parsing, UserImportModal), circulation shelf copy selection & direct return action, book cover image file upload in AddBookModal, physical copy barcode viewer with click-to-copy in BookDetailModal, iOS PWA install prompt mounted, PDFReader zoom/pagination/memory leak fix, purged test DB pollution and added afterAll test fixtures cleanup. 27 Vitest tests passing 100% and zero-error production build.

history.action: Local Development Hosting via Cloudflare Tunnel Setup
history.agent_note: Configured zero-cost public access for development/demo: installed cloudflared, configured vite.config.ts allowedHosts & host binding, added npm run dev:public and start-server-public.bat.

Remediated schema validation for DIGITAL_ONLY books (mandatory PDF upload enforcement in CreateBookSchema & AddBookModal), safeguarded BookDetailModal against borrowing unattached digital documents, hardened Vitest test runner with --no-file-parallelism for SQLite safety, and optimized Vite production bundle splitting into modular vendor chunks (reduced main chunk from 857kB to 319kB).

history.action: Physical & Hybrid Book Reservation Workflow (Option A)
history.agent_note: Implemented end-to-end self-service physical book reservation: DB migration (reservation_code, reserved_until, RESERVED/CANCELLED enum), Drizzle schema, atomicity with BEGIN IMMEDIATE/COMMIT, circulation service with 24h expiration and quota check, REST endpoints (/reserve, /claim, /cancel-reserve, /reservations), BookDetailModal reservation action, MyBooksPage Tiket Reservasi tab with copy ticket code, countdown, and cancellation dialog, CirculationDesk Klaim Reservasi tab with 1-click handover and code validation. 32 Vitest unit/integration tests passing 100% and production build verified.

Remediated 10 audit findings: Restricted static serving exclusively to covers (preventing direct unwatermarked PDF download), protected /stream-pdf with digital loan authorization check (403 for non-borrowers), added is_renewed column to loans schema, implemented atomic 1-time physical loan renewal (+7 days) in CirculationService and exposed POST /api/circulation/physical/renew, enforced circulation suspension checks (unpaid fines & overdue loans), changed PDFReader URL to #toolbar=0&navpanes=0 to prevent native print/download bypass, ensured offline IndexedDB eviction on e-book return, decoupled digital and physical borrowing in BookDetailModal for hybrid books, added WebRTC camera-based BarcodeScannerModal and renew buttons to CirculationDesk and MyBooksPage, and expanded Vitest test suite to 36 tests passing 100% with clean Vite production build.

history.action: Superadmin Account Management, Self-Service Physical Checkout, & Instant Physical Return (v1.1)
history.agent_note: Implemented 3 major revisions: (1) Superadmin Panel (SuperAdminPanel.tsx) for multi-role account creation, status toggling, password reset, and self-registration tab in LoginPage.tsx for STUDENT/TEACHER; (2) 100% working self-service physical book borrowing (POST /api/circulation/physical/borrow-self) directly from BookCard, BookDetailModal, and MyBooksPage with decoupled digital/physical borrow states; (3) Instant physical book return at any time without waiting for due date expiry (POST /api/circulation/physical/return-self) from MyBooksPage and 1-click return in CirculationDesk. Verified 42/42 Vitest tests passing and clean Vite production build.

history.action: Full Codebase Audit & Security Vulnerability Assessment
history.agent_note: Identified 10 defects across RBAC privilege escalation (public self-registration role injection), PWA Workbox cache leak of DRM PDF streams, desk circulation quota bypass, unhandled SQLite transaction concurrency in auto-expiration and book creation, UI quota ambiguity (digital vs physical), Command Palette reader integration, barcode availability validation, CSV export status completeness, and PDF watermark responsive rendering.

Remediated all 10 audit findings: (1) Restricted SelfRegisterSchema and selfRegister service to STUDENT and TEACHER only with 400 Bad Request rejection for ADMIN/LIBRARIAN; (2) Excluded /stream-pdf from Workbox PWA runtime cache in vite.config.ts; (3) Unified active physical loans + reservations quota check in desk checkout; (4) Wrapped autoExpireReservations in BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with atomic stock recalculation; (5) Wrapped addNewBook in atomic transaction; (6) Decoupled digital and physical quota badges in MyBooksPage; (7) Connected loan states, reservation code, and PDF reader modal to Command Palette in App.tsx; (8) Disabled selection of non-AVAILABLE copies in BookDetailModal; (9) Completed CSV circulation report status mapping; (10) Added ResizeObserver and window resize listener to PDFReader watermark canvas. Verified 44/44 tests passing and clean Vite production build.

Conducted deep second-pass audit identifying 10 new defects across Path Traversal (/stream-pdf), Multer MIME spoofing & Stored XSS, NaN route params, digital loan concurrency race conditions, missing DB indexes, non-atomic available copies updates, unbatched CSV import writes, and PDFReader/API client resilience.

Executed complete 3-wave remediation: (1) Enforced strict path sandboxing on /stream-pdf and body path traversal checks in book.controller.ts; (2) Hardened Multer upload.middleware.ts with strict AND checks and extension whitelist eliminating Stored XSS; (3) Added positive integer parameter validation in auth.controller.ts and book.controller.ts; (4) Wrapped borrowDigitalBook in atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; (5) Added composite & foreign key performance indexes in SQLite bootstrap DDL; (6) Converted updateAvailableCopies to atomic SQL expression; (7) Wrapped CSV user import batch loop in single SQLite transaction; (8) Enhanced PDFReader with specific 401/403/404 error states; (9) Added safe non-JSON response parsing in api.ts; (10) Synchronized Header Doc in book.service.ts. Verified 47/47 Vitest tests passing and 0-error production build.

history.action: Production Deployment Architectural Hardening & Multi-Platform Enablement
history.agent_note: Resolved critical production deployment gaps: (1) Mounted Express static file serving for Vite 'dist' and SPA wildcard fallback (* -> index.html) enabling unified single-unit deployment on port 3001; (2) Replaced deprecated Node v20 '--loader tsx' with '--import tsx' in package.json start script and Dockerfile CMD; (3) Added 'start:public' and 'start-production-public.bat' for 1-click zero-cost production deployment with Cloudflare Tunnel HTTPS; (4) Hardened Dockerfile directory creation for /app/uploads/covers; (5) Comprehensive deployment.md documentation across 4 target platforms (Windows Local + Cloudflare Tunnel, On-premise Docker Compose, Cloud VPS Ubuntu Nginx+PM2, and Cloud PaaS). 67 Vitest tests passing 100% and clean Vite production build.

history.action: Vercel Serverless + Turso SQLite + Supabase Storage Hybrid Architecture
history.agent_note: Architected zero-compromise Hybrid Cloud engine: (1) Created api/index.ts and vercel.json for Vercel Serverless routing with static dist edge CDN; (2) Integrated @libsql/client in src/server/db/index.ts enabling Turso SQLite cloud connection when TURSO_DATABASE_URL is set, while retaining local better-sqlite3; (3) Created StorageService hybrid in src/server/services/storage.service.ts with Supabase Storage bucket integration and multer.memoryStorage fallback; (4) Verified 67/67 Vitest tests passing 100% and clean Vite production build.

history.action: 20 MB E-Book Upload Limit & Vercel 4.5 MB Serverless Payload Limit Bypass
history.agent_note: Resolved HTTP 413 Payload Too Large on Vercel deployment: (1) Diagnosed Vercel Serverless Function hard 4.5 MB request body limit causing HTTP 413 on PDF uploads > 10 MB; (2) Implemented Direct Signed Cloud Upload in storage.service.ts via createSignedUploadUrl & createSignedDownloadUrl; (3) Added POST /api/books/presign-upload endpoint enforcing 20 MB limit and delivering signed Supabase URLs; (4) Updated AddBookModal.tsx with client-side 20 MB validation, badge indicator, and direct-to-cloud upload sending only lightweight JSON metadata to Vercel; (5) Raised Express body-parser limit to 25mb and adjusted Multer; (6) Added signed URL redirect (HTTP 307) on /stream-pdf to prevent Vercel 4.5 MB response truncation; (7) Verified 69/69 Vitest tests passing and 0-error production build.

history.action: Conditional Book Deletion with Storage Cleanup and Active Circulation Guard
history.agent_note: Implemented end-to-end book deletion: (1) Added StorageService.deleteFile() for local disk and Supabase cloud file cleanup; (2) Added BookRepository countActiveLoansAndReservations() and delete() cascading past returned loans and book copies; (3) Added BookService.deleteBook() wrapped in SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction with active loan & reservation guardrail; (4) Exposed DELETE /api/books/:id with LIBRARIAN/ADMIN RBAC protection; (5) Added ApiClient.deleteBook() with local cache invalidation; (6) Integrated destructive AlertDialog confirmation and delete trigger in BookDetailModal.tsx and CatalogPage.tsx; (7) Verified 75/75 Vitest tests passing 100% and 0-error production build.

decisions.title: Conditional Book Deletion with Active Circulation Guard and Automated Storage Cleanup
decisions.rationale: Menghapus buku pada sistem perpustakaan harus menjamin integritas relasi sirkulasi dan kebersihan penyimpanan. Sistem memblokir penghapusan buku yang sedang dalam masa peminjaman aktif atau reservasi (HTTP 400). Jika tidak ada sirkulasi aktif, penghapusan dilakukan secara atomik pada basis data (buku, eksemplar, dan pinjaman lampau yang sudah berstatus RETURNED) serta membersihkan berkas cover dan PDF di storage lokal atau Supabase secara otomatis.

decisions.title: Direct Supabase Storage Upload via Signed URLs for Large E-Books (20 MB)
decisions.rationale: Vercel Serverless Function membatasi payload request dan response maksimal 4.5 MB (HTTP 413). Dengan menggunakan Signed Upload URL dan HTTP 307 Signed Stream Redirect, berkas PDF hingga 20 MB dialirkan langsung antara browser dan Supabase Storage CDN tanpa membebani edge proxy Vercel.

decisions.title: Superadmin Account Management & Self-Service Physical Circulation
decisions.rationale: Memfasilitasi pendaftaran mandiri Siswa/Guru dan kendali penuh Superadmin (ADMIN), serta memungkinkan peminjaman dan pengembalian buku fisik secara instan kapan saja tanpa harus menunggu tanggal jatuh tempo habis.

decisions.title: Physical & Hybrid Book Reservation (Option A: Pick-up Ticket)
decisions.rationale: Memberikan pemustaka kemampuan memesan buku fisik/hybrid langsung dari aplikasi dengan kunci eksemplar 24 jam dan tiket unik (RSV-...) yang diserahkan di meja sirkulasi pustakawan.

decisions.title: Zero-Cost Local Development Hosting via Cloudflare Tunnel
decisions.rationale: Memungkinkan akses publik HTTPS gratis untuk pengujian PWA di smartphone/internet luar tanpa merusak arsitektur SQLite/local storage.

decisions.title: Hybrid Library Model (Digital & Physical)
decisions.rationale: Mendukung e-book reading (PDF in-app) sekaligus sirkulasi fisik konvensional (rak, barcode, denda).

decisions.title: Standardized PDF E-Book with Dynamic Watermark
decisions.rationale: Format PDF dipilih karena stabilitas rendering di PWA mobile/desktop dan kemudahan proteksi hak cipta via canvas watermark.

decisions.title: Local School Account Management
decisions.rationale: Import NISN/NIP via CSV tanpa dependensi eksternal SSO.

decisions.title: Modern Academic Minimalist Theme
decisions.rationale: Palette ramah mata untuk sesi membaca panjang (Sepia/Dark mode) dan Bottom Navigation mobile-first.

decisions.title: Anti-AI Slop Hybrid UI Architecture (Shadcn + Aceternity Accents)

decisions.title: SQLite (better-sqlite3) & Drizzle ORM
decisions.rationale: Embedded single-file DB memudahkan backup sekolah dan memiliki latensi super rendah.

decisions.title: In-App PDF Canvas Rendering with Dynamic Watermark
decisions.rationale: Menghindari pembajakan file e-book sekolah tanpa memerlukan lisensi DRM pihak ketiga yang mahal.

decisions.title: PWA Service Worker + IndexedDB Offline Strategy
decisions.rationale: Menyediakan pembacaan luring pada perangkat iOS dan Android.
